title: Show item stats in modal (mobile)
description: Mobile users can't hover for Wowhead tooltips — now stats are shown directly inline in the item modal.

title: Paperdoll clicks open item modal instead of Wowhead
description: Clicking an item icon in the paperdoll now opens the detail modal instead of navigating away.

title: Gem modal shows correct quality color
description: Fixed: all gems appeared as epic purple. Now shows correct rarity color.

title: Gem modal shows Wowhead tooltip inline
description: Gem details (stats, socket info) now appear directly in the modal.

title: Mobile paperdoll overflow fix
description: Paperdoll no longer overflows on small screens — responsive grid with smaller icons.

title: Mobile tooltip positioning fix
description: Tooltips on mobile no longer clip off-screen — centered fixed positioning.

title: Sim disclaimer moved to compact info icon
description: The long sim disclaimer is now a hover tooltip, saving vertical space.

title: Profession filter moved higher on page
description: Profession filter is now above the gear list so it's easier to find.

title: 2H weapon tooltip not showing on hover
description: Fixed: hovering inactive 2H weapon slot showed no tooltip.

title: Neck moved from Armor to Jewelry category
description: Neck slot now grouped with Rings and Trinkets.

title: WarcraftLogs rankings link in meta banner
description: Added direct link to WarcraftLogs rankings per spec/phase.

title: Show Relic for Paladin/Shaman/Druid paperdoll
description: Paperdoll correctly shows Relic instead of Rng for those classes.

title: Hunter stat labels: Ranged Hit/Crit/Haste
description: Hunters now see ranged-specific stat labels instead of melee ones.

title: Fix WCL Ring/Trinket slot mapping
description: Ring 1/2 and Trinket 1/2 from WarcraftLogs were not matched correctly.

title: Updated gems from wowtbc.gg data
description: 129 gem recommendation changes synced + missing gem colors added.

title: Wowhead guide items as alternatives
description: Added items from Wowhead class guides as supplemental alternative picks.

title: PvP 2H weapons reclassified correctly
description: Fixed PvP weapons incorrectly categorized as Main Hand.

title: Public feedback page
description: Feedback & Roadmap page where users can submit suggestions and see progress.

title: Export gear list as shareable image
description: Allow users to export their BiS list as a shareable image for Discord.

title: Compare two specs/phases side by side
description: Show a diff view to compare gear changes between phases or specs.
